## Maximum Likelihood Estimation {#sec-Maximum_Likelihood_Estimation}
The maximum likelihood estimator (MLE) is obtained by maximizing the (log-)likelihood function with respect to the parameter of interest.

## Sandwich Estimator {#sec-Sandwich_Estimator}
The sandwich estimator

Under the central limit theorem
$$
\sqrt{n}\left(\hat{\theta} - \theta\right) \xrightarrow{d} \Nd{0, V(\theta)}
$$

$$
V(\theta) = A(\theta)^{-1} B(\theta) A(\theta)^{-1}
$$


## One-step Estimator {#sec-One_step_Estimator}
The one-step estimator is an iterative method for computing the MLE, requiring a starting value for the parameter of interest. However, as the name suggests, it only performs a single update from the initial estimate.
